evaluator.name: TrackEval
evaluator.config: MOT17 val_half; identical for every comparable pipeline
evaluator.gt_parsing_contract: MOTChallenge gt column 7 (flag) must equal 1; class column 8 must equal 1 (pedestrian). Classes {3,4,5,6,9,10,11} are non-person and dropped; classes {2,7,8,12} are ignore-person regions and are neither scored nor counted as reference identities. Visibility (column 9) is NOT thresholded.

lineage_groups.L: ByteTrack-derived dti; six deployments; 100% identical normalized token stream for ByteTrack/OC-SORT/Hybrid-SORT/SparseTrack, BoT-SORT +1 print, Deep-OC-SORT n_min default 25->30

stv.anchors: the two bracketing R0 observations of a synthesized row
stv.reference_assignment: per-frame one-to-one assignment against scoreable GT, computed on R0 BEFORE any synthesized row is introduced, and then frozen
stv.algorithm: Hungarian one-to-one on IoU with the gate applied as a hard admissibility mask before assignment
stv.licensed_phrase_rule: Only ANCHOR_ID_MISMATCH licenses 'anchors resolve, under the frozen matcher, to different ground-truth identities'. ANCHOR_UNMATCHED is non-admission, NOT demonstrated semantic error.
stv.not_a_metric: STV is a reference-side diagnostic and never a replacement tracking metric
stv.sensitivity_status: DESCRIPTIVE; the 0.5 result remains primary regardless of sensitivity outcome

materiality.denominator_justification: The denominator is synthesized rows because the criterion concerns the composition of what the post-processor produced, not of the whole submission.
materiality.mandatory_companion: the corresponding fraction of total submitted R2 rows must ALWAYS be reported alongside, so a large conditional fraction cannot be read as a submission-wide effect

ordering.no_selective_inspection: all pairs reported, not only those that flip
ordering.estimand_warning: These are SYSTEM-LEVEL deployment orderings. A cross-pipeline ordering difference must NOT be attributed solely to the post-processing family, because tracker and detector systems differ. Within-pipeline R0->R2 deltas and between-pipeline ordering are separate estimands.

row_additive.R0: raw tracker output immediately before the audited interpolation stage
row_additive.R2: output immediately after the frozen documented interpolation call
row_additive.invariant: R0 subseteq R2 by row identity; pre-existing R0 rows field-identical up to normalised serialisation
row_additive.row_identity: (sequence, frame, track_id) after the frozen parser normalisation
row_additive.normalisation_allowed: numeric formatting/precision of the writer only; no coordinate or id change
row_additive.on_failure: do NOT construct R1; classify the cell STRUCTURAL_DECOMPOSITION_UNAVAILABLE
row_additive.R1: R0 plus only those synthesized R2 rows admitted by the frozen STV criterion; GT-informed diagnostic only; never deployable

non_row_additive.forbidden: no R1 analogue may be forced
non_row_additive.S0: state immediately before the audited transformation
non_row_additive.undefined_rule: If the transformation rewrites values that its own regression/smoothing fit consumes, a row-subset causal decomposition is declared STRUCTURALLY_UNDEFINED. This is an allowed outcome, not a failure of the study.

stop_conditions: population not reproducible from a frozen manifest (currently: MOT20, DanceTrack)
documented rule needs an undocumented parameter choice
evaluator configuration differs across comparable pipelines
a supposedly row-additive implementation rewrites existing rows
GPR RNG not externally fixable/replayable without changing scientific source semantics
CLI is not the actual execution path
any real V9 metric/STV outcome inspected during protocol or CLI development

wording_contract.required: State that the repository's documented TEST-set post-processing rule was applied unchanged to a pre-specified validation population.
wording_contract.forbidden: Do not state or imply that the repository documents post-processing use on the validation split for these cells.
wording_contract.correction_note: This corrects over-broad wording that appeared in frozen V8 ('under their documented post-processing rules' applied to a validation population). V8 is NOT edited; the correction binds V9 language only.
wording_contract.exempt: PRIMARY_DOCUMENTED_VALIDATION cells (Deep-OC-SORT; StrongSORT++ MOT17) may state that validation use is documented, because it is.

rng_seed_contract.harness_rule: the harness seeds NumPy/random global state immediately before calling the unmodified upstream entry point
rng_seed_contract.replay: exactly one same-seed replay is required as reproducibility verification
rng_seed_contract.replay_is_not_a_trial: replay values must never be averaged or pooled with the first execution
rng_seed_contract.on_failure: status = REPRODUCIBILITY_FAILURE; no quantitative GPR ranking claim is licensed
forbidden: choosing a seed because of an observed output

amendment.title: separate documentation role from structural audit mode

amendment_a2.title: freeze pre-V9 outcome knowledge status; correct score and ID-rewrite implementation semantics

interpretation_contract.HISTORICAL_OUTCOME_KNOWN_PRE_V9: may be replayed through the V9 CLI as implementation validation and as part of the systematic universe, but MUST NOT be described as a prospective V9 result
interpretation_contract.PROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME_UNSEEN_AT_V9_FREEZE: may receive prospective interpretation only if all protocol and executable conditions were frozen before execution
interpretation_contract.STOPPED_UNSEEN: outcome remains unseen because execution is stopped (e.g. corpus not acquired)
interpretation_contract.reporting_requirement: The paper must report how many EXECUTED cells were historical versus genuinely prospective. A blanket statement that all outcomes were prospectively frozen is FORBIDDEN.
